knowledge.purpose: Links to the same page in each of the app languages, each named in its own language, the current one marked.
useCases: Language links in the top bar of a site in several languages
Language choice on a documentation page
antiPatterns: Links written by hand to another locale home page: the switch keeps the visitor on the same page
A select or dropdown that navigates on change
Placing it in a single-language app: it draws nothing there
knowledge.implementation: A <nav> (named by the app word ui.language; English when unset) of links built from context.locales (order) and context.alternates (the current page address in each locale, written as a link to it is, so used as given). Each link carries hreflang and lang of its language and is named in that language (Deutsch, Türkçe) unless labels names it; the current locale (context.locale) carries aria-current="page". With fewer than two locales the block draws nothing. separator: rule draws a thin rule between links. In the editor a click reports the address instead of leaving. Needs engine 3.5.

jsonSchema.description: The name shown for a locale, e.g. {"de": "DE"}. Unset, each language is named in itself.
Between the links: a gap, or a thin rule.
